name: Anything App: Create with AI
subtitle: Your ideas. Your little apps.
description:
Turn a little idea into an app you can actually use.

Describe what you have in mind — a habit tracker, focus timer, plant journal, calculator, creative tool, or playful game — and Anything App creates it with AI. Try it, ask for changes, and save it to your own private library.

• Create with a simple description
• Open your apps right inside Anything App
• Ask for revisions whenever inspiration strikes
• Keep your favorite apps in one place
• Save mini app data on your device
• Explore the complete HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
• Try three included starter apps without an account

Sign in with Apple to create and save. New accounts receive 10 free credits. Each creation or revision uses one credit; failed generations return it. No ads, subscriptions, or in-app purchases.

AI creation is for ages 18 and older and requires an internet connection. Your prompts and existing app source are sent to Anthropic only with your permission. Your library is private and stored with Supabase. Mini apps run in a sandbox and cannot access native features such as camera, contacts, notifications, or payments. App source syncs across your account; data entered inside mini apps stays on the device. Apps using online libraries or resources need internet.

Start with a thought. Make it yours.
promotionalText: Imagine a little app. Describe it. Make it yours — with AI creation, easy revisions, and a private library of your own.
reviewNotes:
Anything App lets adults create PRIVATE HTML/CSS/JavaScript mini apps with a direct Anthropic request, preview and revise them, and save their source in their own account. It is not an app marketplace. There is no public feed, shared catalog, messaging, or user-to-user content.

REVIEW: The home screen includes three fully functional starter apps with no login. Open Focus flow, Daily dots, or Little notes; local data persists after reopening. To test AI creation, choose Create app, Sign in with Apple using your own Apple account, declare age 18+, allow the Anthropic data-sharing prompt, and describe a small tool. Each reviewer receives 10 free credits; failed generations are refunded. Generation usually takes 30–120 seconds. Open the result, Save to my apps, reopen it, and use Edit app to request a change.

Generated code runs in an opaque WKWebView iframe with no Apple credentials, native permissions, or platform API access. A bounded per-app storage shim saves only local key-value data. HTTPS libraries support tools and 3D experiences. The code button exposes full source. Provider filtering and generation instructions reject objectionable content. Report a problem is available inside every generated app; Delete app removes it. No other users can contact the reviewer, so abusive-user blocking is not applicable. The private library serves as the index; each record has a private universal-link path /apps/{id} on app-api-production-e73b.up.railway.app. Only the owner can access the app source.

Settings includes privacy/support, withdrawal of AI permission, sign out, and permanent account deletion. No purchases, ads, or tracking. Data entered inside mini apps remains on the device; prompts and source are sent to Anthropic only after explicit consent. AI creation is age-gated for declared adults and the rating is 18+.
